items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) listed QUESTIONABLE for SNF vs DAL despite full practices; Giants elevated Braxton Berrios and signed Dalen Cambre as depth.
items.why: Returning from ACL; full practice but official Q designation and contingency elevations.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT or limited, Fields/Mooney/Berrios rise; Likely TE upside if Nabers limited.
items.opportunity: If active, heavy target share; monitor pregame.

items.text: Falcons QB Cooper Rush experienced back spasms Saturday but will still start Sunday at PIT; Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) OUT.
items.why: Tua oblique from practice; Rush spasms but team confirms start.
items.implication: Still start Bijan/London/Pitts; Rush game-manager limits ceiling slightly but volume intact.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is OUT for Week 1 (and expected 1-2 games) after meniscus trim procedure; Michael Mayer steps into expanded TE1 role.
items.why: Meniscus trim this week; confirmed by coach and multiple reports.
items.implication: Mayer becomes must-start TE streamer/upside play; targets shift to Mayer and WRs.
items.opportunity: Mayer target share spike, routes, red-zone.

items.text: Patriots officially placed WR A.J. Brown on injured reserve (high ankle); signed DT DaQuan Jones.
items.why: High ankle sprain; IR placement confirmed.
items.implication: Out multiple weeks minimum; NE WR room thins, Maye targets to others.

items.text: Cowboys placed RB Malik Davis on IR after hip surgery (season-ending); signed Israel Abanikanda from PS.
items.why: Hip injury Friday practice, surgery Saturday, no return designation.
items.implication: Javonte Williams unchallenged lead; Demercado/Abanikanda depth; lose handcuff value.

items.text: ETR/Pat Thorman Week 1 snaps & pace: NO @ DET up in pace (fast expected); MIA @ LV slow-paced slog.
items.why: Historical + projected neutral pace/PROE factors; Saints/Lions high volume.
items.implication: Prefer DET/NO skill players for volume; fade MIA/LV pace-dependent.

items.text: Raiders TE Michael Mayer agreed to 3-year $45M extension ($30M gtd, ~$15M APY 4th among TEs); first Raiders rookie-deal extension since Renfrow. With Bowers OUT, immediate role expansion.
items.why: Extension + Bowers absence creates clear path.
items.opportunity: Targets, routes, red-zone in Bowers void.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) fully practiced and cleared/expected to play Week 1 vs MIA with no designation after earlier scare; ADP boost noted.
items.why: Full practices mid-week; team hopeful and no game designation.
items.implication: Start as RB1; monitor early workload management possible with missed camp.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries/routes vs soft MIA run D.

items.text: ETR context: Emeka Egbuka (toe) and Ja'Marr Chase clearances/expected IN for Week 1 after limited/rest; Jeanty/Love also positive signals.
items.why: Practice progression and no OUT designations.

items.text: Berry Love on Saquon Barkley: since joining PHI, 136.5 rush yds/6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in all 4 games vs WAS (incl playoffs); WAS front still projects below avg.
Berry Fact: Isaiah Likely 4th in TE FPP target last 3 yrs; 8/9 games with 6+ targets = 12.5+ PPR. Nabers won't be 100%; Giants WR2 is Fields or Mooney. Gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Efficiency + Nabers limitation creates target vacuum.

items.text: Berry keeping Chuba Hubbard 'open' as viable flex this week (The Chubbler); not locked but playable.
Unlikely Jaguars & WR Parker Washington agree to extension by season start; explored Michael Wilson-range deal (3yr/$75M) but no deal; betting on himself.
items.implication: Motivated for big year; startable WR.

items.text: No last-minute contract extension for Ravens QB Lamar Jackson before opener (unlike Dak 2 yrs ago); deal on hold likely until 2027. Reluctant talks.
items.implication: No distraction; focus on field. All eyes on play.

items.text: Packers TE Tucker Kraft agreed to 4-year extension base ~$75M one day before opener.
items.why: Long-term deal locks in core TE.

items.text: Matthew Berry contrarian: not worried about CMC usage/preseason or Kaelon Black looks; banged-up preseason + long flight + weird game = BUY LOW on Christian McCaffrey.
items.why: Context of limited prep/travel; historical resilience.

items.text: Berry: In games with Tyler Shough, Chris Olave 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75%; Lions safeties on IR; high O/U. Shough waiver available widely.
Berry Fact: Justin Herbert fantasy PPG/attempt 52% higher with Joe Alt on field last year; Alt healthy for Week 1 vs ARI (weak DL/secondary).
